description: Golden parity for the PURE sum kernel sumMoneyWithRates(rows, to) in @tims/shared (Slice 11c). The live packages/api/src/lib/currency.ts sumMoney delegates to it; the C# Tims.Domain.Compensation.CompensationKernels.SumMoney mirrors it. Asserted IDENTICALLY by the REAL TS export (tests/currency/convert-money-fixtures.test.ts) and the C# unit test (Tims.UnitTests). FIXED rates only. Pins: total = Sum of roundMoney(amount*rate) per row THEN roundMoney(total) (round-then-sum-then-round, matching the live sumMoney); converted = ANY row whose from != to (identity rows never flip it); empty rows -> {amount:0, converted:false}.

cases.name: mixed USD + COP summed in USD: 100 + (400000*0.00025=100) = 200, converted true
all identity same currency: 50 + 25 = 75, converted false
empty rows -> zero total, converted false
round-THEN-sum: two 1.005 rows -> roundMoney(1.005)=1.01 each -> 2.02 (NOT sum-then-round 2.01)
single converted row flips converted even with an identity row present
